Welcome users, create organizational messages, and enable feedback for Microsoft Copilot
Feedback
Summarize this article for me
Microsoft Copilot
is an AI-powered productivity tool that helps users with everyday tasks.
As part of your
Microsoft Copilot adoption
, send a welcome email to your Microsoft Copilot users on license assignment that announces Microsoft Copilot and its features. You can also enable feedback for Microsoft Copilot users.
Additionally, admins can use Organizational Messaging in the Microsoft Admin Center to deliver tailored in-product messages to your users directly through Teams.
This article provides information about how to send users a welcome email, enable feedback, send organizational messages, and review the Microsoft Copilot usage activity report.
This article applies to:
Microsoft Copilot
Send welcome email
After you assign a Microsoft Copilot license to a user, the system automatically sends a notification email that can look like the following email.
The welcome email also includes a link to
Microsoft Copilot help and learning
.
Send an in-product notification to your users through Organizational Messaging.
Organizational messages
Admins can send a customizable in-product message through Teams with organizational messaging in the Microsoft Admin Center. After you
set up Microsoft Copilot and assign licenses
to your users, notify them with your message in-product telling them that they can now use Microsoft Copilot.
Admins can configure their message through the Microsoft 365 admin center.
In your Microsoft 365 admin center, in the navigation pane, select
Setup
.
On the Setup page, in the
Featured collections
section, select
Advanced deployment guides & assistance
.
Select
Set up Microsoft Copilot
.
On the
Set up Microsoft Copilot
page, in the
Promote using Microsoft Copilot
tile, select
Schedule message
.
The
Organization messages
pane displays and shows the default message and how it displays to your users. If you choose to use it, select the recipients, schedule when and how regularly you want the message to be delivered to your users, and then select
Schedule message
.
Create a custom message
If you want to create a custom message instead of using the default one, at the bottom of the
Organizational messages
pane, select
More customization
. You can then create and deliver messages to targeted groups of users in your organization.
Select
Create a message
.
Select an objective, such as Adoption, Onboarding, Sustainability, or Training. Select
Next
.
Select where you want your message to display, such as the Notifications area, Taskbar, Teaching popover, or Windows spotlight. Select
Next
.
Choose to create your own message or start with a premade template. Select
Next
.
Write your message, and then select
Next
.
Select your target audience, and then select
Next
.
Schedule how long and how often you want your message to appear to your recipients. Select
Next
.
Review your selections, and then select
Schedule
.
Enable feedback
Enable all feedback settings for the Microsoft 365 Apps.
This option allows Microsoft Copilot users to provide details with a thumbs up or thumbs down reaction to a Copilot prompt response.
To enable the feedback for your users, use the
cloud policy service
or group policies.
When all the policies are enabled, users can provide logs, screenshots, and a contact email address for their feedback submission.
Review the Copilot usage activity report
After your users start using Copilot, run and review the
Microsoft Copilot usage report
. This report summarizes user adoption, retention, and engagement with Microsoft Copilot.
Find the report in the
Microsoft 365 admin center
>
Reports
>
Usage
.
To learn more about the Microsoft Copilot reports, see
Microsoft Copilot reporting options for admins
.
